findings.note: Listed as a co-sponsor (not primary) of SB 352, short title Remove Foreign Citizens from Voting Rolls, filed in the Senate 3/22/2023. As filed, it requires citizenship to serve as a juror and has jury-excuse names for non-citizens shared with the State Board of Elections, which reviews their voter registration and citizenship status and removes non-citizens from the rolls. Last action: referred to Rules and Operations of the Senate, 3/23/2023.

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading, roll call 693 (Aye 28, No 13)
findings.note: Senate roll call vote on the second reading of HB 958, Election Law Changes. The latest edition of the bill on the bill page (https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958) includes new G.S. 163-83, which says a voter registration application is processed only if it affirmatively indicates the applicant is a U.S. citizen, plus removal of non-citizens from voter registration records. The same bill covers many other election topics. I could not confirm which edition was voted on 7/28/2026. His vote on the amendments the same day is also listed on the votes page.
